card.name: Linking words before change or difference terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, a, as, or) and the word weight in clinical-trial or warning text, right before a word about change, increase, or difference from baseline. It is anticipating a change-type word next.

modes.label: Link word before change
modes.description: A small word like of, a, or as sits just before an expected increase/change term.
modes.example: The finding<< of>> increased risk with AEDs of varying

modes.label: Measure before change
modes.description: A measured quantity such as weight comes just before the word change from baseline.
modes.example: mean<< weight>> change from baseline within the initial 4

modes.label: Or before an adjustment
modes.description: The word or links a pause with a dose adjustment.
modes.example: pause the taper for a period of time<< or>> raise the dose of the opioid analges

card.writes: It suppresses change-type words (change, changes, in several languages), so it seems to mark where a change word is already expected or should not repeat.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before the text talks about a change or increase, such as in a trial result.
